title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the tennis match between Luis Carlos Alvarez and Axel Nefve in the San Salvador, originally scheduled for November 27, 2026 at 11:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Luis Carlos Alvarez' if Luis Carlos Alvarez advances against Axel Nefve.

This market will resolve to 'Axel Nefve' if Axel Nefve advances against Luis Carlos Alvarez.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by December 11, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the ATP Tour. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
